professionalSummary.text: Experienced SRE with a focus on monitoring and alerting for dispatch and parts-order services, having designed, validated, and maintained Prometheus/Grafana solutions across multiple release cycles.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote Prometheus alerting rules and Grafana dashboards for the dispatch API and the parts-order queue, and validated them against replayed traffic in the staging cluster over four release cycles.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored and validated alerting rules and dashboards for dispatch API and parts-order queue across four release cycles, ensuring reliability before production release.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote Prometheus alerting rules and Grafana dashboards for the dispatch API and the parts-order queue, and validated them against replayed traffic in the staging cluster over four release cycles.

experienceHighlights.text: Participated in on-call rotation and incident reviews, drafting timelines and follow-up actions for March dispatch outage.
experienceHighlights.witness: Took part in the incident review for the March dispatch outage as the monitoring owner for staging, drafting the timeline and the follow-up actions that service operations then reviewed.

experienceHighlights.text: Submitted monitoring changes through the platform team's release pipeline, coordinating with release calendar and documenting responsibilities.
experienceHighlights.witness: Submitted monitoring changes through the platform team's release pipeline; production releases were executed by the platform team's on-call engineer under their release calendar, and I had no production deployment permissions.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained alerting runbooks, noting known limitations such as staging-only tuning for queue-depth alerts.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the alerting runbook for the dispatch service, including the known limitation that queue-depth alerts were tuned only against staging traffic profiles.

skills.text: Prometheus, Grafana, Alerting Rule Design, Dashboard Development, Release Pipeline Coordination, Incident Review Documentation, Runbook Maintenance
